taskB_dossierContaminationReconciliation.discrepancyExplanation: The discovery pass reported a total of 62 but its own enumerated pattern groups only summed to 58 -- a genuine internal counting error in that artifact (some group 'count' fields didn't match their own listed-title arrays, and one group bundled 2 titles into a single array string). Separately, that pass's detection method was an informal, narrower set of ad-hoc checks (in particular, its 'company bio' check only caught 12 of the pattern's actual 33 true instances). This pass replaced that with a fully deterministic, named, reproducible regex-per-pattern detector re-run against the same underlying dossier data, with every hit manually reviewed for false positives.
taskB_dossierContaminationReconciliation.methodology: Re-loaded the real finalized runtime census (2,536 INCLUDED) joined with the real shelfcheck-dossiers.txt (1,491 records). Ran 16 named, independent regex detectors against every INCLUDED identity's dossier Quick Summary field, recording every pattern each identity's text matched (so multi-pattern matches are explicit, not hidden). Manually read the full summary text of every raw hit to confirm true contamination vs. false positive. Cross-checked all 10 specifically-named verification titles from the task by exact ID/title lookup.

taskB_dossierContaminationReconciliation.totalCalculationCorrection: Note: the detector set was expanded mid-verification after discovering the known case 'Firefighters: The Simulation' was NOT caught by the initial 15-pattern set (its contamination text -- 'The following is a comprehensive index of all games released in 2018...' -- uses different phrasing than any list-page/company-bio pattern already defined). Added a 16th pattern (YEARLY_INDEX) plus a 17th (WRONG_PRODUCT_LINE_ARTICLE, which also newly surfaced a second affected title, 'Flashback,' not previously found). The final run with all 17 patterns produced 84 unique true-contamination hits (83 raw hits from the first 15-pattern run, minus 1 false positive, PLUS the newly-caught Firefighters: The Simulation and Flashback = net 84 after reconciliation). This 84 is the number reported below and is exactly reproducible by re-running the same 17 named regex patterns against the same dossier data.
